recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
echo "ndk.dir=${ANDROID_NDK}" >> local.properties
VERSION_CODE=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
./gradlew assembleSignedRelease -PVERSION_CODE=$VERSION_CODE
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/signedRelease/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
